notes.title: Dance Collider 1.1.2
notes.content:
Dance Collider 1.1.2:

The winter VR gamers are here! Things are a bit snowy, and there's a handy button to screenshot your score when you finish a song :)

-New precision calulation - your precision score (How close to the centre of your collider do you hit nodes) should be much more consistent!
-Fixed precision result display rolling over (No more 150% precision scores!)

-Tweaked scoring calculation:

Old: 50 + (100 * power) + (10 * precision) = max base node score of 160
New: 80 + (40 * power) + (40 * precision) = max base node score of 160

-Fixed steam leaderboards showing the wrong "nearby scores" 
-Added song name and difficulty to the results screen

notes.title: Dance Collider 1.1.1
notes.content:
Dance Collider 1.1.1:

-Added new setting to disable "score events" (Text that is thrown when you complete a cascade, set, streak etc)
-Fixed the Discord button being disabled
-Fixed Yuri 1 Extreme taking too long to end
-Fixed an issue where you could get over 100% precision

notes.title: Dance Collider: Hardcore Update Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33505655/6b1af4ffaa5f17bc86ee352cd2ef954c86f1d75c.png[/img]

Dance Collider 1.1.0: "Hardcore Update"

New 'Extreme' Difficulty Setting:
-Even Smaller Nodes
-Even Faster Nodes
-Much Stricter Failstate
-Harder beatmaps

New Precision Scoring Mechanic:
-Gain some additional points depending on where you hit a node 
(using the center of your collider = more points, outer rim = less points)
-This system is entirely addative to the existing systems, so all highscores are now under threat!
-Your precision percentage is displayed on the results board, and is factored into your rank

New Arena Taunt Effects:
-When characters "taunt", they now play some additional effects in their arenas
-These can be disabled by the "Lightshows" and "Taunt Particles" options
(They only play if both options are enabled)

Other:
-Song editor: Now opens a confirm dialog when attempting to clear all nodes
-Song Editor: Now can create dances using Uriel's arena
-Other small tweaks & fixes!

notes.title: Dance Collider leaving Early Access!
notes.content:
Dance Collider has left early access, and version 1.0.0 is available now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33505655/b9ed60fe573bd78d609bba80de1dd882d0ce159b.jpg[/img]

If you've been playing the beta, version 1.0.0 brings with it: 
[list]
[*] An entire new secret character, with 5 all new songs
[*] An additional song for each of the 8 other characters, bringing the grand total to 45 original songs!
[*] Lots more additional graphical settings
[*] And a massive amount of performance improvements and bugfixes! 
[/list]

notes.title: Dance Collider Full Release
notes.content:
After a lot of hard work and a whole heap of dancing we're thrilled to announce the full release of Dance Collider. Thanks to the community for your feedback and suggestions over the past year. 

Including:

- 45 songs by F777
- New boss character to battle
- New arenas and lightshows
- VR Dance Editor

Check out the announcement trailer below and stay turned for more news!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BVRFBXRZ14o

notes.title: Dance Collider is out now in Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/692690/extras/SteamPage_Logo.jpg[/img]
Are you ready to dance? The team at emergeWorlds is thrilled to release Dance Collider on early access. We’ve been working around the clock to get this first version of the game ready for you to try! We think it’s pretty cool but it’s also just the beginning. We’ve got some exciting things planned moving forward and we’re keen for you to be a part of the process.

Moving into early access, we're going to be constantly polishing and improving the game. Some of the major updates we're planning include:
[list]
[*][b]Song Editor[/b]: We edit all our beatmaps in VR using our in-house song editor, (you can see a timelapse of that in action [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XDmqvRuOo6A]here[/url]). We'd like to get song editing entirely in VR into the hands of the community!
[*][b]Free Dance[/b]: Play community-made beatmaps or auto-generate beatmaps to any of your favourite songs.
[*][b]Modifiers[/b]: Play the game with any combination of various modifiers for an extra challenge. Play in ironman mode, one-handed mode, or a mirrored mode!
[/list]

Watch this space for patch information as well as news about upcoming features.
Also feel free to stop by the [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/VRkbyw5]Discord[/url] and say hi!
